_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your real values. config.json is gitignored and NEVER committed.
_inventory_comment: Auto-restock: order-triggered checks run on every receipt sync; periodic sweep uses inv_watch_interval_minutes. Set auto_restock_enabled to false for alert-only (ZERO_STOCK events, no Etsy PUT). Requires listings_w OAuth scope.
_pre_transit_comment: pre_transit_days: upper bound (in days) for how long after label creation we query carrier tracking for an order. With the 4PX tracking integration active (Pass D in sync worker), this is NOT the primary pre-transit signal — carrier_confirmed_at IS NULL is. This value controls how far back we look for unconfirmed orders to check. 30 days is the default — it gives a generous window so even slow-moving packages are checked. Once carrier_confirmed_at is set (carrier physically picked up the package), the order immediately moves to In-transit regardless of this value.
_fourpx_comment: 4PX Official Open Platform API credentials (https://open.4px.com). When set, the sync worker uses the authenticated tr.order.tracking.get endpoint to determine precise pre-transit/in-transit status for 4PX shipments. These credentials ALSO power the 'Create 4PX Shipment' feature in the Orders tab. Register at https://open.4px.com to obtain these values.
_fourpx_order_comment: 4PX shipping order creation settings. These three fields enable the 'Create 4PX Shipment' button on unshipped orders. fourpx_sender: your warehouse/shipper address in China. fourpx_warehouse_code: the 4PX warehouse code where you drop off packages (e.g. 'CNSZX01' for Shenzhen SZX, ask your 4PX account manager if unsure). fourpx_default_product: the default logistics product code used to pre-select the dropdown (e.g. 'BDS' for Business Direct Small — confirm with your 4PX account). Leave fourpx_sender null to disable the shipment creation feature.
_osp_comment: Shopping Route Generator integration. Set osp_project_dir to the absolute path of your Orders_sorting_program project. The dashboard Route tab will call the Python script directly to generate shopping_route.xlsx from the browser. osp_python defaults to 'python' — change to 'py' on Windows if that is your Python launcher, or set the full path to python.exe.
_auth_note: OAuth access tokens expire in 1 HOUR. Store the refresh_token here (valid 90 days). The TokenManager handles refreshing automatically. If refresh_token expires after 90 days, re-run oauth:setup for that shop.
_email_imap_comment: OPTIONAL — per-shop email_imap block enables the Messages tab email sync feature. Etsy sends a notification email to the shop's linked Gmail/Outlook account whenever a buyer sends a message. This dashboard polls that inbox via IMAP, parses the emails, and displays the conversations here. GMAIL SETUP: (1) Enable 2-Step Verification on the Google account. (2) Go to Google Account → Security → App Passwords. (3) Choose 'Mail' and generate a 16-character app password. (4) Use that code as `password` — NOT your regular Gmail login. OUTLOOK: use your regular password or an app password if MFA is enabled. Leave out the email_imap block entirely to skip email sync for that shop.

shops._note_api_key: Find keystring in Etsy > Manage Apps. x-api-key header = keystring:shared_secret (both required per Etsy API docs)
shops._note_refresh_token: Complete OAuth flow via 'npm run oauth:setup'. Paste the refresh_token returned here (format: 12345678.xxxxx). Access tokens expire in 1hr but are auto-refreshed from this.

groups._comment: Use proxy "direct" when the shop does not use VPN/IPFoxy. Each shop still needs its own api_key + shared_secret from that Etsy developer app (max 5 shops per key).
groups.label: Direct connection (no proxy)

shops._email_imap_note: Add this block to enable the Messages tab for this shop. Etsy sends message notifications to the Gmail account linked to this shop. Use a Gmail App Password (not your real password).
